GIS Tech Must Become Cornerstone of Governance: Arunachal Pradesh Governor

2026-08-07 The Arunachal Times GIS, governance, Arunachal Pradesh, Esri India, Geo Vision Itanagar, drone mapping, border development, geospatial platform
Read the source article

Quick summary

Arunachal Pradesh's Governor KT Parnaik told a Geo Vision Itanagar seminar organized by Esri India that GIS technology must become a cornerstone of governance, advocating drone-based mapping, unified geospatial platforms, and data-driven decision-making across all government departments.

Key takeaways

  • Governor KT Parnaik emphasized that GIS technology must become a cornerstone of governance in Arunachal Pradesh, addressing the 'Geo Vision Itanagar' seminar organized by Esri India
  • The governor urged all government departments to adopt GIS-based systems for data-driven decision-making, citing the state's unique geographical profile
  • Drone-based GIS mapping was specifically advocated for the state's diverse terrain and border development needs
  • The governor called for a unified geospatial platform to integrate data across departments and eliminate siloed decision-making
  • The seminar was organized by Esri India, highlighting the company's role in promoting GIS adoption among Indian state governments
